$comment: Hand-curated non-journal uses. Only add an entry with a verification trail (where/when it was checked). No counts here — these are not OpenAlex data. Optional link_en/link_zh override the CTA; omit only if url is absent.

uses.en: World Resources Institute's Resource Watch hosts the urban-expansion probability projections as dataset “cit.005a Urban Expansion Probabilities”, citing the 2019 ERL paper.
uses.zh: 世界资源研究所（WRI）的 Resource Watch 平台收录了城市扩张概率预测数据集（“cit.005a Urban Expansion Probabilities”），并引用了 2019 年 ERL 论文。
uses.link_zh: 前往 Resource Watch 查看 →

verified.how: Resource Watch API dataset bf14690e-a3d8-466b-b382-04876f27caf1 metadata citation field names Huang, Li, Liu & Seto (2019), ERL 14:114037, doi:10.1088/1748-9326/ab4b71; explore URL returned HTTP 200.

uses.builds_on_short: ERL 2019 · urban expansion to 2050; Nat Commun 2020 · SSP urban land projections
uses.en: IPCC AR6 Working Group III Chapter 8 (Urban systems and other settlements, 2022) cites the 2019 ERL urban-expansion and heat-island projections in the text, Table 8.1, and Figure 8.10, and cites the 2020 Nature Communications SSP urban-land projections (Chen et al.).
uses.zh: IPCC 第六次评估报告第三工作组第 8 章《城市系统与其他住区》（2022）在正文、表 8.1 与图 8.10 中引用了 2019 年 ERL 城市扩张与热岛预测，并引用了 2020 年《自然·通讯》SSP 城市用地预测（Chen 等）。
uses.link_zh: 查看 IPCC 第 8 章 →

verified.how: Downloaded IPCC_AR6_WGIII_Chapter08.pdf from ipcc.ch. In-text and Figure 8.10 caption name Huang et al. (2019); references list Huang, K., X. Li, X. Liu, and K.C. Seto, 2019, Environ. Res. Lett. 14(11), 114037, doi:10.1088/1748-9326/ab4b71. Same PDF references Chen, G. et al., 2020a, Nat. Commun. 11, 537, doi:10.1038/s41467-020-14386-x (Kangning Huang co-author).

uses.en: IPCC AR6 Working Group III Chapter 2 (Emissions Trends and Drivers, 2022) cites the 2019 ERL paper on ambient warming from urban land expansion as a driver of higher air-conditioning and cold-storage energy use.
uses.zh: IPCC 第六次评估报告第三工作组第 2 章《排放趋势与驱动因素》（2022）引用 2019 年 ERL 论文，说明城市用地扩张带来的升温会推高空调与冷藏能耗。
uses.link_zh: 查看 IPCC 第 2 章 →

verified.how: Downloaded IPCC_AR6_WGIII_Chapter02.pdf from ipcc.ch. In-text: ‘ambient air temperature caused by urban land expansion, which will likely drive a substantive increase in air conditioning use and cold storage for food (Huang et al. 2019).’ References: Huang, K., X. Li, X. Liu, and K.C. Seto, 2019, doi:10.1088/1748-9326/ab4b71.

uses.en: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper 9618, The Evolution of City Form: Evidence from Satellite Data (Lall, Lebrand & Soppelsa, April 2021), cites the 2019 ERL projection of 0.6–1.3 million km² of new urban land by 2050.
uses.zh: 世界银行政策研究工作论文 9618《城市形态的演变：来自卫星数据的证据》（Lall、Lebrand 与 Soppelsa，2021 年 4 月）引用了 2019 年 ERL 关于 2050 年前新增 0.6–1.3 百万平方公里城市用地的预测。

verified.how: Downloaded PRWP 9618 PDF from documents1.worldbank.org. Body quotes Huang et al (2019) urban land expand by 0.6–1.3 million km² between 2015 and 2050; references list Huang, Kangning, Xia Li, Xiaoping Liu, and Karen Seto. 2019, doi:10.1088/1748-9326/ab4b71. Also at https://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-9618.

uses.en: UN-Habitat white paper Cities and Nature: Planning for the Future (December 2022, CBD COP15 information document) cites the 2019 ERL finding that the urban footprint will increase by 78%–171% over 2015 by 2050.
uses.zh: 联合国人居署白皮书《城市与自然：规划未来》（2022 年 12 月，CBD COP15 信息文件）引用 2019 年 ERL 结论：至 2050 年城市足迹将比 2015 年增加 78%–171%。
uses.link_zh: 查看联合国人居署 PDF →

verified.how: Downloaded white_paper_cities_and_nature_rev2.pdf from unhabitat.org. Body: ‘the urban footprint will increase by 78%–171% over 2015 (Huang et al, 2019).’ References: Huang, Kangning et al (2019), Environ. Res. Lett. 14 (11): 114037, DOI 10.1088/1748-9326/ab4b71.
